observations.why: Present-tense rule statement anchored in realis by 'now requires'; past event 'we saw' is concrete evidence grounding the gate.
States a standing rule as current settled policy — present realis at the abstract level of a general requirement.
Declares current applicability of the gate as a general scope rule — present realis, abstract category.
Assigns a named individual as current owner — present realis at the concrete level of a particular person.
